# Visionary Nexus — Agent Logic Layer

## CORE PRINCIPLE
Agents are autonomous logic units that execute defined responsibilities within the ecosystem.

They are not scripts.
They are structured intelligence behaviors.

---

## 1. AGENT BEHAVIOR MODEL

Each agent follows:

- Input → Context received
- Process → System rules applied
- Output → Structured result
- Feedback → System refinement loop

---

## 2. AGENT AUTONOMY RULE

- Agents operate within defined scope
- Agents cannot modify core system rules
- Agents can suggest system improvements
- Agents are replaceable at all times

---

## 3. AGENT COMMUNICATION

- Agents communicate via structured outputs
- No unstructured data exchange allowed
- All outputs must be system-readable

---

## 4. AGENT TYPES LOGIC

### Builder Agent
- Translates ideas into system modules
- Focus: construction and structure

### Analyzer Agent
- Evaluates system efficiency
- Detects inconsistencies

### Automation Agent
- Executes workflows
- Maintains event-driven actions

### Integration Agent
- Handles external system connections
- Keeps abstraction layer intact

### Security Agent
- Monitors system integrity
- Ensures access compliance

---

## 5. EVOLUTION RULE

Agents evolve through:
- version updates
- rule refinement
- system feedback loops

No agent is static.
